reviewDescription: I’ve used this for months. Time for a review. First, this is hands down the most comfortable and most adjustable. Sound is adequate… nothing amazing but good enough. The one complaint I have is charging it. You have to plug directly into the speaker and it’s not easy to get to. I’ve had several nights of disappointment because it’s way too easy to fail to secure the plug. It holds maybe two nights charge but I try to charge it every night. I hate where the charging port is. If not for this, I’d give it 5 stars.
reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on October 3, 2026
